location: Lampiran 1 Penyata Perbelanjaan Mengurus: B.24 Kementerian Perdagangan Antarabangsa dan Industri, program 060000 'ONE-OFF'
anomaly: The program subtotal 'Jumlah 060000' prints sebenar 6,293,310.19 (81.20%, varian 1,457,171.81), RM1,000,000 less than its only aktiviti 060100 Persidangan APEC 2020 (7,293,310.19; 94.10%; varian 457,171.81) and than its own three object lines (581,675.09 + 5,711,635.10 + 1,000,000.00). The 40000 Pemberian line of RM1,000,000 is left out of the subtotal
proof: The printed prestasi and varian of the subtotal are computed from the understated figure (6,293,310.19 / 7,750,482 = 81.20%; 7,750,482 - 6,293,310.19 = 1,457,171.81), so the error is in the printed subtotal, not in our reading. The ministry total JUMLAH KEMENTERIAN 561,835,163.41 equals the sum of the aktiviti subtotals, not of the program subtotals (560,835,163.41). Page text: qa/evidence/2021_PENYATA_KEWANGAN_KERAJAAN_PERSEKUTUAN.pdf/p142.txt
resolution: Kept as printed; sum leaf rows (golden rule 5), which gives the correct 7,293,310.19
explains: core: opex_detail[sebenar_rm]: program leaf sums = printed Jumlah program (bad groups)|1|0|1 ; core: opex_detail[varian_rm]: program leaf sums = printed Jumlah program (bad groups)|1|0|1

location: Perangkaan Kewangan Kerajaan Persekutuan 2012-2021: Perubahan Dalam Modal Kerja, FY2015 and FY2014 columns
anomaly: Wang Tunai dan Pelaburan + Pinjaman Bersih should equal Tambahan/(Kurangan) Modal Kerja. FY2015: 7,411 + (43,743) = (36,332) vs printed (36,335), off by 3. FY2014: (8,242) + (42,588) = (50,830) vs printed (50,813), off by 17
proof: FY2014: this volume restated net borrowing to (42,588) but kept the old working-capital figure; the 2017 volume prints (42,571) and (8,242) + (42,571) = (50,813) exactly. FY2015: the 2022 volume prints 7,411 + (43,745) = (36,334), a comparative-cell typo (validate.py DIAGNOSES). FY2013 is off by 1, within the check's rounding tolerance. Page text: qa/evidence/2021_PENYATA_KEWANGAN_KERAJAAN_PERSEKUTUAN.pdf/p293.txt
resolution: Kept as printed; each year taken from its own volume (golden rule 6)
